caption: The drawing shows a single broad-bladed tool with a short wooden handle. The handle is oriented horizontally and colored with shades of light and medium brown, suggesting a wood grain texture. The blade is large, rectangular with slightly angled corners, and appears rusty, rendered in various shades of reddish-brown and dark brown, with patches of darker and lighter areas giving it a mottled, worn appearance. The upper part of the blade curves upward to encircle the wooden handle, attaching it to the blade. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details. The entire composition centers on the tool, with the head of the blade facing downward and the handle parallel to the top edge of the drawing.
title: Broad Axe
